name: Eyes of Gods
source:
People… 
In a rotten world where people have forgotten the definition of "humanity", two coalitions fight for power. One of them is the Order which keeps under its heel a puppet government and another one is the Alliance – a gang of yesterday’s bandits who decided to take power. Which way to choose? Who has truth behind them? Should one reject the old rules and rely on the ideas of the future? The truth is to be looked for in the tricky tangles of people’s destinies, hopes and vicious desires. 

And what about gods?... 
The Order uses the faith in them for its black deeds. And the main asset of the Order are not donations from millions of believers but children born with black eyes. These children are called "seers" because they can see the future and look within the mysteries of the past.

The player follows the path of Luca, a hitman who was born with only one god’s eye. You will have to decide which party to join in an unfolding conflict between the Order and the Alliance, and also to determine who really Luca is – a simple murderer or something more.

[Edited from [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/eyes-of-gods-a-cyberpunk-visual-novel--2#/]Indiegogo page[/url]]
translation:
人们……

在一个忘记“人性”定义的腐朽世界里，两大阵营争夺权力。一方是踩在傀儡政府头上的教团，另一方是由昔日强盗组成、决定夺取权力的联盟。该选择哪一方？真相究竟站在哪边？是否应该抛弃旧规则，依靠未来的理念？答案隐藏在人们命运、希望与邪恶欲望的复杂纠葛中。

神明又如何……？

教团利用对神的信仰实施黑暗行为。教团最大的资产不是数百万信徒的捐款，而是那些天生拥有黑色眼睛的孩子。这些孩子被称为“预言者”，因为他们能看见未来，也能窥探过去的谜团。

玩家将跟随路卡的道路前进。他是一名天生只有一只神之眼的杀手。你必须在教团与联盟不断升级的冲突中选择加入哪一方，同时决定路卡究竟是谁——普通杀人犯，还是更加特殊的存在。
